versions.changelog:
- Minor update release.
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md for clarity and minor corrections.
- Removed legacy skill-card.md to streamline documentation.
- Made adjustments in scripts/furnace_check.py (details not specified in diff).

Initial release of Furnace Panic Doctor: instant furnace troubleshooting and safety triage.

- Step-by-step, no-tools diagnostic tree for any furnace “no heat” event
- Separates DIY fixes, professional repairs, and urgent safety shutdowns (“stop now” lines)
- Guides users through common causes: filters, thermostats, pilot lights, error codes, smells, and noises
- Automatically generates a technician briefing sheet from what’s checked and the model info
- Built-in freeze protection advice if heat loss is delayed
- Safety triage runs first and halts diagnostics for serious risks (CO, fuel, fire)
